method: momentum-resolved quantum-kinetic (Boltzmann) production; Y_s=n_s/s entropy-normalised; free-streaming via frozen spectrum <eps> matched to Viel Lyman-alpha thermal bound

nonresonant_DW.note: DW production for 100% DM requires a mixing ~2.6 dex above the XRISM X-ray bound -> non-resonant sterile is X-ray excluded (quantified)

resonant_ShiFuller.edge_tension: in the fixed-L pass the X-ray-allowed point (L=2e-03, <eps>=3.03) is WARM and the coldest point (L=2e-04, <eps>=1.57) is X-ray-EXCLUDED by 1.5 dex -> the 7.1 keV sterile sits at the X-ray/Lyman-alpha edge; threading BOTH needs the full L-depletion QKE
resonant_ShiFuller.note: resonant production reaches Omega_DM at ~582x smaller mixing than DW; a cold spectrum (<eps> down to 1.57, 0.48x DW) is achievable but at an X-ray-excluded L

free_streaming_lyman_alpha.note: Lyman-alpha mass floor: ~41 keV (non-resonant, reproduces the cited combined bound) -> ~15 keV at the coldest resonant spectrum (Viel 5.3 keV bound) -> ~9 keV (coldest + conservative 3.5 keV bound). Model 5.6 keV and benchmark 7.1 keV sit below all -> under pressure, quantified

caveats.abundance_normalisation: absolute DW/RP normalisation carries a known ~factor-2 QCD-epoch g_*(T) uncertainty; DW sin2=6.1e-9 for Omega_DM at 7.1 keV reproduces the literature ~3-4e-9 to within it. Robust outputs are RATIOS (X-ray-exclusion dex, coldness, floor).
caveats.resonant_model: FIXED lepton number L (no back-reaction depletion) — a standard first-pass. It captures the resonant enhancement and the existence of cold spectra, but the anti-correlation (cold<->X-ray-excluded) is likely exaggerated vs the self-regulating full QKE; whether one (L,sin2) threads both X-ray and Lyman-alpha needs sterile-dm-class L-depletion codes.
caveats.hydro: no 3D hydrodynamic Lyman-alpha simulation run (out of sandbox scope, as stated); linear free-streaming <eps> matched to published simulated flux-power bounds (Viel 2005/2013) — the standard field methodology.
caveats.eps_convergence: spectrum <eps> converged to <0.1%% under 4x eps/T refinement and 10x lower T_lo (so the L-dependence of <eps> is physical, not a grid artifact).

verdict: Full Boltzmann narrows the F203 margins to computed numbers. (1) ABUNDANCE/X-ray: non-resonant DW for 100% DM needs sin^2 2theta = 6.1e-09, 2.55 dex ABOVE the aggregate X-ray bound -> DW is X-ray excluded (was order-of-magnitude, now 2.5 dex). (2) RESONANT: production reaches Omega_DM at up to ~582x smaller mixing; it clears the X-ray bound for L>~2e-03, and cold spectra (<eps> down to 1.57 vs DW 3.29) exist - but in this fixed-L pass the X-ray-allowed and cold-spectrum regimes DON'T coincide (the 7.1 keV edge tension). (3) LYMAN-alpha: the mass floor is 41 keV non-resonant -> 15 keV at the coldest resonant spectrum (Viel) -> 9 keV (coldest + conservative bound). The model's 5.6 keV and the 7.1 keV benchmark sit BELOW even the most relaxed floor -> the keV sterile is under quantified pressure as 100% DM, viable only as a sub-dominant component or if the full L-depletion QKE threads the cold + X-ray-allowed corner. NET: F203 T1/T2 pressure CONFIRMED and QUANTIFIED (2.5 dex X-ray exclusion of DW; ~9 keV Lyman-alpha floor vs a 5.6 keV model), not removed.
